xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex002032026-07-0605-02-50" status="unreviewed"><rs type="person" ref="db:3745" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">jo bo</rs>s dper na dang por dgra btson du 'dzin pa dang* | nyam smod pa dang | mtshon dang po brgyab pa dang* | mtshon gnyis pa brgyab nas gnad du phog pa dang | dgra shi ba'i gnas skabs lnga yod pa bzhin du | rtog pa btson du 'dzin pa dang | mgo gnon pa dang* | rags pa spong ba dang | phra ba spong ba dang* | rtog pa 'gags pa'i gnas skabs lnga bshad pa dang mthun par | sngon gyi <rs type="person" ref="db:4189" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">dwags po</rs> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4294">khyung po</rs> la sogs pa ni rnam rtog bzhi po spong ldan pa zhes | rtog pa bzhi ni spang bya yin la de dag gi de spong ba'i gnyen pos khyad par du 'phags pa yin no zer ro || </seg></TEI>
